facts.fact: AELEX legal analysts in BusinessDay say the CBN's June 2026 payments circular requires financial institutions and other payment participants to store and manage payment transaction data generated in Nigeria within Nigeria, with full compliance required from 1 January 2027.

systems.country_label: CBN circular on market structure, data localisation, UBO disclosure and systemic oversight

note: NITDA cloud document is described as a proposal on hosting higher-sensitivity government data in Nigeria; noted, not a rule in force.
